ALIS Valves offers Y Type TC End Control Valves designed for controlled flow regulation in hygienic and sanitary process piping systems. These valves feature a Y-shaped body configuration that provides a streamlined flow path, helping reduce flow resistance while supporting precise adjustment of the process flow. TC, or Tri-Clamp, end connections allow quick installation and removal using compatible clamps and gaskets, making these valves convenient for cleaning, inspection and maintenance. A movable plug and seat mechanism regulates the flow passage, while a compatible manual or actuated operating mechanism adjusts the valve opening according to process requirements. Depending on the design, these valves may feature stainless steel construction, suitable sealing materials and hygienic product-contact surfaces for compatible industrial applications.

Y Type TC End Control Valves are suitable for food and beverage processing, dairy production, pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, cosmetics and other hygienic applications requiring controlled fluid flow. Depending on the valve construction and material selection, they can handle compatible liquids and process media within their specified pressure and temperature limits. Important selection factors include valve size, Tri-Clamp connection standard, stainless steel grade, flow coefficient (Cv or Kv), operating pressure, temperature range, process media and required control accuracy. Buyers should also consider gasket compatibility, the required flow characteristic and suitability for clean-in-place (CIP) procedures where applicable. For automated applications, the actuator and control signal must match the plant’s process control system. Selecting the appropriate Y type TC end control valve helps provide efficient flow regulation, convenient maintenance and reliable performance in compatible hygienic processing systems.
